title: The 4 Best Yoga Mats Under $60
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for yoga mats under $60, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at yoga mats under $60 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: prAna E.C.O. Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 5mm closed-cell natural rubber, Two-sided texturing for grip, Non-toxic, PVC-free construction.
strengths: Natural rubber grip and durability meaningfully outperform foam mats in this price bracket
PVC-free construction appeals to practitioners avoiding synthetic materials
Two-sided texture holds up better under sweat than basic foam
limitations: Rubber smell out of the box takes a week or two to fully fade
Fewer ratings than mass-market foam mats, less long-term data available
features: Typically $65 to $75, watch for sales under $60

products.name: Gaiam Essentials Thick Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 10mm (2/5-inch) NBR foam cushioning, Textured non-slip surface, Easy-cinch carrying strap.
strengths: 10mm cushioning is comfortable for both practice and general floor exercises
limitations: Foam construction doesn't match the durability of rubber mats at the top of this budget range
Grip performance under heavy sweat trails behind rubber options

products.name: BalanceFrom GoYoga All-Purpose Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-inch (6mm) high-density foam, Double-sided non-slip texture, Includes carrying strap.
strengths: 6mm cushioning and double-sided texture cover general practice reliably
limitations: Foam wears faster than rubber options also available in this price range
Better suited to buyers prioritizing accessories over a premium single mat

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
